programme.title: Matlock: The Priest
programme.desc: A lawyer friend of Matlock’s puts his faith in the crafty attorney when his client is accused of killing a feisty priest, Father Fitzgerald.

programme.title: Matlock: The Witness
programme.desc: Ben Matlock gives his assistant, Michelle Thomas, her toughest courtroom assignment... breaking down the eyewitness testimony of a former law classmate in a brutal murder case.

programme.title: Matlock: The Best Seller
programme.desc: District Attorney Julie March matches wits with tempestuous author Cynthia Slayton, whose torrid novels are suddenly eclipsed by facts surrounding the death of her best friend.

programme.title: Matlock: The Hunting Party (Part 1)
programme.desc: The serenity of historic Roanoke Island is shattered when a retired career soldier attempts to prove his late brother’s death was not a hunting accident, but murder.

programme.title: Matlock: The Good Boy
programme.desc: When Tony Morgan, a smooth-talking, seemingly perfect son, frames his mother for murder, no one even suspects his involvement. No one except Ben Matlock, who tries to prove the good boy isn’t so good after all.

programme.title: Matlock: The Ex
programme.desc: Ben Matlock finds himself in an awkward situation when he joins Julie March in Baltimore to help her defend an old friend accused of murder.

programme.title: Matlock: The Clown
programme.desc: Matlock holds the last ray of hope for a veteran circus clown, Homer Fleming, accused of murdering his partner during a performance.

programme.title: Matlock: The Star
programme.desc: Ben Matlock uncovers plots within a plot when Noel Bishop, the wunderkind director of horror films, is accused of murdering motion picture star Catherine McKay as the cameras roll.

programme.title: Matlock: The Con Man
programme.desc: Ben Matlock has serious doubts about a code of ethics among con artists which is never supposed to include murder.

programme.title: Matlock: The Prisoner (Part 1)
programme.desc: Ben Matlock accepts the most dangerous case of his career when he agrees to defend an inmate accused of murder – before a kangaroo court in a riot-torn prison.

programme.title: Matlock: The Prisoner (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock must protect his own life while he’s in prison trying to defend his client. Meanwhile, Conrad tries to unravel the prison murder plot from outside the walls.

programme.title: Matlock: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Ben Matlock is left with a lot of questions and no answers when his client, Drew Carey, bolts from the courtroom during a preliminary hearing for murder.

programme.title: Matlock: The Buddies
programme.desc: A deathbed letter from an old friend puts the life of Ben Matlock in peril when he feels morally obligated to reopen a murder case more than three decades old.

programme.title: Matlock: The Scrooge
programme.desc: The senseless murder of a toy store owner not only clouds the Christmas spirit, but threatens an annual party and gifts of toys to local orphans.

programme.title: Matlock: The Student
programme.desc: A philandering college professor is murdered in his classroom and Marcy Hansen is the prime suspect, having announced her pregnancy in an argument before witnesses.

programme.title: Matlock: The Talk Show
programme.desc: Ben Matlock and Michelle Thomas are exposed to a quick course in trash television when a vicious talk show host, Don Galloway, humiliates three prominent women to boost his ratings.

programme.title: Matlock: The Victim
programme.desc: Ben Matlock is convinced that Alex Gordon, a paraplegic, murdered his wife and framed his business partner, Bret Howell, for the crime.

programme.title: South Park: Hobbiten
programme.desc: Wendy försöker att para ihop en av sina väninnor med Butters, men det slutar med att hon hamnar hos skolkuratorn.

programme.title: South Park: #Omtugg
programme.desc: Kyle vill spela tv-spel med sin lilllebror, men Ike vill inte längre spela med honom, så Kyle blir rädd för att nästa generation håller på att köra om honom.

programme.title: South Park: Glada hologram
programme.desc: 'Cartman, polarn' trendar medan resten av USA förbereder sig för det största julprogrammet nånsin på TV.

programme.title: South Park: Fabulös och modig
programme.desc: Killarna visar Caitlyn Jenner sin enormt stora respekt i det mest fabulösa och modiga 'South Park'-avsnittet nånsin.

programme.title: South Park: Trygg plats
programme.desc: Cartman blir offer för kroppsförnedring.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Klassens nya kille övertalar Jesus att kämpa för hans far, Satan, i den slutliga kampen om mellan godheten och ondskan. Cartman blir upprörd när han hör att dusten är på samman dag som hans födelsedagskalas.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman och Kyle blir osams om en magisk triangel de hittar under en arkeologisk utgrävning. Triangeln har kraften att omvandla Barbra Streisand till ett otäckt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans morsa är en slampa
programme.desc: Dr Mephisto hjälper Cartman att gräva fram sanningen om hans pappas identitet. Strålkastarljuset skiner på ett antal invånare i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Staden vid avgrundens rand (återblickar)
programme.desc: Skolbussen hamnar på kanten av en ravin efter en snöstorm.

programme.title: South Park: Chefhjälpen
programme.desc: Chef försöker göra anspråk på royalties från ett skivbolag när de släpper en låt som han påstår att han skrev för 20 år sedan.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Cartman och Kenny är fast i den senaste trenden från Japan, en tecknad serie som heter Chinpokomon - men vad är den hemliga planen bakom programmets antiamerikanska motiv?

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av Cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle behöver en njurtransplantation och Cartman är en perfekt donator, men Cartman sätter ett högt pris på sin njure: 10 miljoner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman måste dö
programme.desc: Cartman blir ursinnig på Scott Tenorman när rödhårige Scott lurar vår medgörlige hjälte att köpa hans pubeshår för 6,12 dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Hooden invaderar
programme.desc: Eftersom Token känner sig utanför som det enda rika barnet i stan försöker han locka fler rika människor till South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Den nya Terrance and Phillip-filmtrailern
programme.desc: Alla barn i South Park kan knappt bärga sig innan de får se trailern till den senaste Terrance & Phillip-filmen.

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Jimmy och Timmy tror att ett gäng som kallas The Crips är en klubb för handikappade människor och blir medlemmar.

programme.desc: Cartman gör en fingerdocka som liknar J-Lo inför ett multikulturellt evenemang som hyllar latinamerikaner.

programme.title: South Park: Korkad, bortskämd hora-leksaken

programme.title: South Park: Agenturen
programme.desc: Som talangmanager kan Cartman, Stan och Kenny ta 10 % av sina kunders förtjänster. Men efter att de idogt har försökt att imponera på sin enda kund stjäls han av en annan manager.

programme.title: South Park: En miljon små fibrer

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med tvåan i pissoaren

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: After heading out to a mountain cabin, Jesse goes missing, only to turn up five days later in Utah, claiming to have been abducted by aliens.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Amanda cruises into cyberspace during a spell of boredom and randomly enters the website "Welcome to Joanne's living room" for mindless entertainment.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Steve joins his troubled partner, Reggie Ackroyd, in a rehab facility for stressed-out cops. Reggie seems delusional and keeps blaming a murderer he caught for abducting his wife and daughter, and Steve encourages him.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: It's a busy day for the homicide unit and Community General when three murders take place. Further investigation reveals that none of the suspects knew their victims, and they are all terminal patients at Community General.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.desc: Richard's dream of being a paid artist comes true when he is commissioned to paint a mural for New York City.

programme.desc: When gentile Del falls for Risa Glickman, who only dates Jewish men, he takes drastic measures to pretend that he is Jewish.

programme.desc: When Annie's sister Donna visits New York in hopes of resurrecting her career, she finds the love letter Richard hid from Caroline and decides that setting the lyrics to music could be her next big hit, forcing Richard to feel slightly off-key.

programme.desc: When Caroline supports Del in his efforts to expand business for her "Caroline in the City" cartoon strip and merchandise.

programme.title: Caroline in the City
programme.desc: Caroline's naive, helpful nature comes out in full bloom when she starts catering to her new elderly neighbor, Miriam, but Annie thinks Caroline is being taken advantage of.

programme.desc: The riotous race of the century pits Alex against Louie in a winner-take-all bet to see who can bring in the most receipts. Lecherous Louie uses every dirty trick in the book to make sure he wins his prize—an evening with Elaine.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Elaine suddenly starts getting mysterious love letters. When she becomes intrigued by the poetic propositions, a couple of cabbies quickly claim responsibility, leaving Elaine with the hilarious task of discovering who is the amorous writer.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a hilarious shock to the cabbies when Rev. Jim brings his new pet to the garage—an over-the-hill racehorse that he bought after cashing in on the 300-to-1 long shot. However, he soon finds that it’s impossible to housebreak a horse.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Lecherous Louie, the dispatcher, becomes a lovesick pup after his girlfriend finds another guy. He will stop at nothing to get her back, including recruiting Alex for his hilarious scheme—and the riotous shenanigans at the Sunshine Cab Co. never stop.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a riotous family reunion when Jim returns home to face his millionaire dad for the first time since he dropped out of society in the ‘60s, and Alex has his hands full with Jim’s voluptuous, overly amorous sister,

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The Taxi gang falls prey to hilarious fear for homeless Elaine’s romantic well-being when chivalrous Bobby allows her to live in his apartment while he is gone. Unexpectedly, he returns before she has found other quarters

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Hilarious sparks fly when Tony tries to fix up his divorced sister with Alex. Instead, she ends up falling for Reverend Jim and Tony goes outrageously overboard trying to break up the affair.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Lecherous Louie the dispatcher has the dubious honor of being selected by his employer’s revenge-seeking wife to be her clandestine lover, and comedic panic grips the love lair when the boss shows up unexpectedly.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Wild and crazy theatrics erupt when Tony decides to become an actor and Bobby, as his skeptical agent, is aghast when Tony lands a role because he is the right type.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.desc: When Latka Gravas is rejected by a young beauty, he sets out on an uproarious crash course to learn to be a swinging American Bachelor, a turnabout that works fantastically with the girls but turns off all of his friends at the garage.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Jim turns into a soothsayer when he warns of a bizarre catastrophe to befall Alex that also involves an affair with a beautiful blonde.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie turns into a jealous romantic when his overtures to accompany Elaine on her European vacation are rejected. Instead, Alex becomes the pretty cabbie's holiday companion on a tour of Europe's hot spots—culminating in a romantic rendezvous.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Riotous confusion prevails when Latka Gravas' split personalities prompt Elaine and Alex to take him to a psychiatrist's office, where the predicament takes on a wild new twist as Latka takes on Alex's personality.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie the dispatcher is gleeful, but Alex is aghast when the romantic affair between Alex and the new waitress at Mario's is complicated by another suitor.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: A jubilant Tony returns to boxing as the manager of a young heavyweight, thrilling Louie, who anticipates recouping his wagering losses to Alex by betting against Banta's boxer.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie carries his actions and insults too far, prompting Elaine to enlist help from a women's organization. Soon, the dispatcher's lecherous laughter is transformed into comical pleading when he is booted out of his job.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Joy blossoms at the Sunshine Cab Co. when a triumphant Bobby Wheeler returns to proclaim that he's landed a TV series role. Louie, in his own charming way, puts a damper on the celebration.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The pretty new cabbie proves to be more than Alex can handle when she leaves the meter running, in an attempt to lure him into romance.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Romance and merriment are on the menu for Tony and Alex when they double-date gorgeous twin models at a posh restaurant, only to have the intimate group grow to a crowd with the unwelcome additions of Jim and Alex's ex-wife.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: Mata Hari. Dance, Seduction and Espionage. The enduring myth.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.
programme.sub-title: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls order a pizza and find Lisa Mail for the challenge the following morning. A huge fight breaks out between Stefanie and Louise.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are taken to Debenhams, where they get the chance to meet Caprice. They are given fifteen minutes to find an outfit for different occasions.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at a bar where they meet music video director Paul Hills. Their challenge is to star in a music video along with The Wolfmen.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are woken up by a grueling morning workout from Celebrity Personal Trainer Nicki Waterman. Some struggle with the workout, especially Sherece.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at Models 1, where they meet Mark Evans along with casting agents. They take a Polaroid shot for a casting. Mark announces that they will be going to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, but there are only four places on the plane.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive in Rio and excitedly explore the luxurious villa they will be staying in. On a rare day off, they are driven to Ipanema to play beach volleyball with local guys, and in the evening, they are joined for dinner by Lisa.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The top three girls take a cable car to Sugar Loaf Mountain to learn Samba dancing.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Aptitude and Natural Talent
programme.desc: All 14 girls are interviewed by the press where they are asked why they want to win. The models pair up and pick each partners best and worst features. The girls receive news about their first photoshoot and later find out it's a topless shoot in pairs.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Poise and Composure
programme.desc: The girls get a crash course in dance with top choreographer Supple and a runway lesson from top fashionista Jeanette. The winners get to take part in a fashion show featuring the work of top designer Scottee - whose dresses are all made out of paper.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Style and Presentation
programme.desc: The girls find out they're getting makeovers in a Lisa Mail. This weeks challenge is a bucking bronco advertisement for the cheesy "Britain's Next Top Model Hairspray". In this weeks photoshoot they have the added element of working with a small dog.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Character and Personality
programme.desc: The girls took part in a challenge for Jai Kudo glasses. At the photoshoot the models are greeted by Gerry Deveaux and Giorgio Guidotti, of Italian fashion house, Primarni for a shoot for the latest collection by SportMax one of Max Mara's labels.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Exhibition and Spectacle
programme.desc: The girls meet with TV star, June Sarpong to learn interview skills and are judged by undercover magazine journalists. The claws are out as the girls critique each other during the challenge. Tension in the house builds.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Drama and Performance
programme.desc: This week the girls learn some new choreography with Supple and in the photoshoot the girls are told they are to pose for an album cover. Lisa Snowdon treats everyone to cocktails with The Bar Wizards -finalists on last years Britain's Got Talent.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Intelligence and Originality
programme.desc: The models face an acting challenge which includes a steamy kissing scene with guest actor Guy Burnet. The photoshoot this week is a couture shot where each girl had to portray a different emotion.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Imagination and Creativity
programme.desc: The girls pose as different types of mannequines for their photoshoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Stamina and Endurance
programme.desc: The girls are put through a series of circus acts and asked to model on plinths in London's streets. The girls also pose for beauty shots in Zandra Rhodes dresses in the style of sporting events.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Beauty and Cover Girl
programme.desc: The girls start the week by attending a casting session with Sadie Frost and Jemima French. They meet up with Caroline Barnes and Sophie Beresiner for a beauty editorial and the photoshoot is for the cover of Company Magazine.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Robin slösar bort alla sina pengar på dyra hobbies. Han har precis gjort slut med Madeleine från förra avsnittet, och med hennes skyhöga skulder och överdrivna utgifter är hans nya liv svårt.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Bibbi är sjuksköterska och ska snart gå i pension, men med sina skulder kommer hon inte att kunna gå i pension vid 67 års ålder. Hennes hus är fullt av kläder, smycken och tomma champagneflaskor. Kommer hon att kunna ändra sin livsstil?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Roy Erik köper och säljer klockor varannan vecka och experterna har aldrig sett ett sådant slöseri. Han köper på impuls och säljer med förlust. Med sin höga skuld kommer han aldrig att kunna köpa ett eget hus.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Helene har en bra inkomst, men i stället för att lägga undan pengar shoppar hon. Hon lägger 13.000 norska kronor i månaden bara på nätshopping och drömmen om att köpa ett eget hus känns avlägsen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Arild blandar ihop sin privatekonomi med sitt företag och har därför tappat kontrollen. Han har skulder på långt över en miljon kronor. Arild är en skicklig tatuerare, men hur kan han rädda sin ekonomi?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Hilde slösar bort sin lön som lastbilschaufför på sitt bilintresse. Hon struntar i räkningarna, kylskåpet är tomt, elen är på väg att stängas av och skulderna växer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Ellinor har sålt sitt hus och är på väg att starta om sitt liv. Trots en bra inkomst har hon det kämpigt. Experterna följer med henne under flyttprocessen och blir chockade över hur mycket pengar som läggs på onödiga inköp.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501
programme.desc: Ørjan har köpt och sålt över 100 bilar under 13 års tid och hans tomt är full av olika fordon. Han har en bra lön, men spenderar desto mer, och när kontot ekar tomt handlas det på kredit.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: Else har skatteskulder och riskerar att bli av med sitt hus. De höga elpriserna och Elses överdrivna konsumtion av kaffe, mat och mobilspel tar över hennes budget och får framtiden att se mörk ut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Odins liv vändes på sin kant när han sjuk i cancer, och nu hindrar skulderna från tiden innan och under sjukdomen honom från att bygga det liv han vill ha.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Sverre och experterna blir chockade då ett brev dyker upp om att Sverres hus måste säljas. Sverre har valt festandet före att bygga klart sitt hus, och har använt fakturor för att tända brasor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Daniel dricker 3 liter läsk om dagen och gamla lån har hindrat honom och Mona från att bilda familj. Mona tror att Daniel spenderat små summor på vadslagning men det visar sig handla om mer pengar.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2506
programme.desc: Ulrik har tagit stora lån för att etablera sig med familjen men har tappat kontrollen och får en otrevlig överraskning när experterna anländer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Madeleine älskar inredning och hennes garderob är full av nyinköpta kläder. När Madeleine vill ha något nytt så köper hon det. Hon lever över sina tillgångar och de dyra lånen hopar sig.

programme.desc: Blake blir misstänksam mot Peter DeVilbis. Claudia får fler violetter från "Lancelot". Adam berättar sanningen om förgiftningsincidenten för Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Allegre återlämnas och Blakes misstankar om Peters inblandning grundas. Tracy iscensätter en presskampanj för att ruinera Krystle.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Peter DeVilbis, som fångas när han försöker lämna landet, arresteras för innehav av narkotika och fängslas. Blake erbjuds en politisk post. Fallon återfår medvetandet och får veta att hon är förlamad.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis försöker muta Kirby för att hindra henne från att gifta sig med Adam. Claudia får ännu ett paket från sin avlidne make. Fallon är fortfarande oförmögen att gå, tills hennes barns liv är i fara.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Krystle får reda på att hon är gravid. Fallon lider av smärtsam huvudvärk. Claudia och Steven besöker Matthews olycksplats i Peru. Väl hemma får Claudia ett telefonsamtal från sin avlidne make.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis gör upp en plan för att störa Blakes affärsuppgörelse med Rashid Ahmed. Tracy försöker förföra Blake och får sparken. Steven blir misstänksam mot Dex, som ringer ett mystiskt telefonsamtal till Claudia.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Dex hittar Alexis med Rashid och vänder sig till Tracy för att få tröst. Kirby får reda på orsakerna till sin fars död och köper en pistol.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Kirby får reda på sanningen bakom sin fars självmord. Krystle berättar för en förbluffad Alexis om sin graviditet. Fallon och Jeff meddelar att de ska gifta om sig.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake reser till Hongkong för att ordna upp oljeaffären med China Seas och får veta att Ahmed har lämnat landet. Mark utpressar Alexis på 100 000 dollar och McVane ser på när han löser in checken.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Alexis förhindrar Blakes förlängning av lånet. Sammy Jo anländer till Denver för att träffa sin son. Efter ett gräl med Alexis hittas Mark död efter ett fall från hennes balkong.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake belånar herrgården för att samla in pengar. Tracy berättar för Alexis om sin affär med Dex. Alexis förhörs om Marks död. Sammy Jo har för avsikt att få vårdnaden om sin son.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Kirbys försök att döda Alexis misslyckas och Alexis lovar att hålla tyst om Kirby lämnar Adam. Sammy Jo avslöjar den skyldige bakom Claudias mystiska samtal.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Efter en allvarlig trafikolycka försvinner Fallon på ett mystiskt sätt. Dex och Steven betalar borgen för Alexis från fängelset. Sammy Jo försöker förföra Adam.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Steven anklagar Adam för att ha konspirerat med Sammy Jo för att kidnappa Danny. Blake ordnar ett lån på herrgården. Han misstänker att Alexis kommer att bli ägare om han inte betalar.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: För att säkra finansieringen av sitt konkursdrabbade företag, ordnar Blake ett möte med Billy Waite, en ökänd oljemagnat. Jeff fortsätter sitt sökande efter Fallon.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: I Seattle får Jeff och Blake veta att kvinnan som dog i flygkraschen med Peter DeVilbis inte kan identifieras, men att ringen hon bar är Fallons vigselring.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: Blake besöker Dominique på La Mirage för att diskutera sitt senaste avslöjande. Hon berättar för Blake att hennes mor var hans fars älskarinna under lång tid och att hon har bevis för det.

programme.title: Dynasty
programme.desc: I vittnesbåset vittnar Steven om att han såg Alexis knuffa Mark till döds. Jeff träffar andra kvinnor i ett försök att glömma Fallon, men förblir besatt av sin ex-fru.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.desc: Den odöda mördaren återvänder i denna blodiga uppföljaren! Den galna polisen Cordell (Robert Z'Dar, Tango & Cash) slår sig ihop med en seriemördare för att jaga de brottslingar som dödade honom. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Raven
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In December 2019, 30-year-old Nadine Lott was brutally beaten by her ex-partner Daniel Murtagh in her Arklow, Ireland apartment. A neighbor witnessed him attacking her "like a wild animal," growling with rage. She died days later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe went on a Tinder date and never came home. The investigation uncovered a calculated murder planned by two predators. A solved true crime case that will stay with you.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was stalked and murdered by her obsessive ex-boyfriend after the system failed to protect her. Her family now fights to make sure it doesn't happen again. A solved true crime case everyone needs to hear.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Horrific Murder of Alice Ruggles

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In October 1983, 15-year-old Tony Muncy's dismembered remains were found in garbage bags along a rural Ohio road. The case went cold for decades until DNA genealogy identified killer Daniel Anderson in 2020.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In November 1993, 19-year-old college student Wanda Musk was abducted at knifepoint from her gas station job in Flint, Michigan, and beaten to death. DNA from a prisoner law finally solved the case in 2013.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 2018, 19-year-old gay college student Blaze Bernstein was lured to a California park by former classmate Samuel Woodward, who stabbed him 28 times. Woodward was convicted of hate crime murder in 2024.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Suzanne Eaton, a renowned American scientist, vanished while jogging on the Greek island of Crete. The investigation into her murder uncovered a killer hiding in plain sight. A solved true crime case you won't forget.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Devastating Murder of Suzanne Eaton // Murdered While on a Run

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Case of Dr. Gulam Moonda // MURDER FOR HIRE PLOT

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Coast Guard mother's baby is found dead in her crib in Alaska. What looked like SIDS turned into a criminal case built on a coerced confession, so the conviction fell apart in court. A true crime case full of unanswered questions.
programme.sub-title: US Coast Guard Confessed to Smothering her Baby, but the Case Fell Apart

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: She sent voice notes to friends saying she feared the worst. Weeks later, a gunman broke into her home looking for her boyfriend and opened fire. A solved true crime case that is devastating, gang-fuelled, and a stark warning about deadly loyalty.
programme.sub-title: She PREDICTED Her Own Murder: The TERRIFYING Killing of Ashley Dale that Lead to MULTIPLE Arrests

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A pastor's pregnant wife is shot during a home invasion while he's at the gym. Police cleared him fast, but the public wasn't convinced. A solved true crime case full of suspicion, conspiracy theories, and heartbreak.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED? The Tragic Murder of Amanda Blackburn // WAS IT REALLY HER HUSBAND?!

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: Illinois serial killer Bruce Lindahl accidentally severed his own femoral artery while stabbing a victim in 1981, dying on the spot. Decades later, DNA forensics posthumously linked him to over 12 murders.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1994, 6-year-old Rikki Neave was strangled by 13-year-old James Watson in Peterborough, England. His mother was wrongly accused. DNA evidence eventually solved the case in 2022, nearly 30 years later.
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Almost Got Away

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A man meets a woman on Facebook who says she needs help. Hours later, his throat is slashed and he's thrown off a bridge into a river. Against all odds, he survived. A solved true crime case that is savage, predatory, and an incredible story of survival.
programme.sub-title: She used Facebook to Lure him in... Then she Slit his Throat & Threw him off a Bridge

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A woman stalks and kills her estranged husband's new girlfriend in broad daylight while witnesses watch. She tried to cover it up, but the evidence was overwhelming. A solved true crime case that is vicious, obsessive, and heartbreakingly avoidable.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Jealous Wife Kills Her Husband's New GF: The Tragic Case of Michelle Boat & Tracy Mondabough

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Belize police superintendent is found dead in the water, shot with his own gun. The only witness? A Canadian socialite with ties to one of the country's most powerful families. Her story didn't add up.
programme.sub-title: MURDER OR ACCIDENT? The Devastating Case of Henry Jemmott and Jasmine Hartin

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 16-year-old calls 911 claiming an intruder killed her mom and her mom's boyfriend. But bloody footprints and security footage told a very different story. A true crime case built on lies that unraveled fast.
programme.sub-title: Teen Thought Dramatic 911 Call Could Fool Cops... But She Forgot One Thing

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En kille ska checka ut men, planer smids bakom stängda dörrar och allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Gårdagens fest har satt sina spår, både i form av bakfylla och tvivel. Det hettar till ordentligt när hotellets brandmän bjuder på show.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Gästerna håller inte igen under Pandoras Ask och den dåliga stämningen hänger kvar länge. Trögpakten bildas, något som inte faller i god jord hos de andra gästerna nu när parceremoni står för dörren.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Vilken pakt får patientens lojalitet? Och vem får checka ut från Paradiset? Det har blivit dags för parceremoni!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det är dags för gästerna att ge sig ut och resa. En bekant säkerhetsvakt checkar in för att stoppa en av resenärerna i tullen.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det hettar till ordentligt mellan två av gästerna, men hemligheten läcker snabbt ut och frågan är vad konsekvenserna kommer att bli. Dessutom checkar en välkänd pilot in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det vankas parceremoni och resan kommer att ta slut för en av gästerna. Stämningen är minst sagt hätsk efteråt och skriken ekar på hotellområdet. Pakterna i paradiset är tydligare än någonsin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Hotellet har förvandlats till en festival. Två artister checkar in, den ena lite mer välkänd än den andra... En av gästerna får det hett om öronen när han måste stå till svars för sina handlingar.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Att vinna tillbaka förlorad tillit är inte lätt, särskilt inte på Paradise Hotel. Kanske kan en blomma lätta upp stämningen?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det mytomspunna hotellet på Mexikos dramatiska västkust slår återigen upp portarna och det är ett taggat gäng som checkar in. Men, allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel och särskilt i händerna på JLC.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: JLC fortsätter styra premiärveckan med järnhand och redan andra dagen kommer tiden på hotellet vara över för några av gästerna. Starka känslor har etablerats mellan flera av deltagarna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Känslorna fortsätter svalla på hotellet och spelet är i full gång. En tjej tvingas checka ut och planer smids inför den kommande parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Säsongens första parceremoni går till historien och efterspelet är inte nådigt. Allianser börja sakta men säkert luckras upp och hur pakterna kommer se ut framöver är högst oklart.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Ny vecka i Paradiset och frågan är om hotellet är en himmel eller ett helvete? Hemligheter avslöjas och två nya gäster checkar in för att röra om ordentligt i grytan.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av de nya gästerna visar sig ha ett förflutet med en av killarna, till hans partners stora förtret. Ett svek uppdagas som vänder upp och ner på hela hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skärselden fortsätter att locka fler offer och ett oväntat erbjudande dyker upp. Hur långt är man beredd att gå för att ta sig vidare? Dessutom har det blivit dags för säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det uppdagas att flera på hotellet har blivit erbjudna samma sak, utan varandras vetskap, och stämningen blir minst sagt kylig. Parceremonin närmar sig, men innan dess ska en av tjejerna checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Parceremonin tvingar ytterligare en tjej att checka ut och frågan är, kan lojalitet leda till attraktion? Åtminstone verkar det fungera så på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skolveckan är i full gång och det vankas prov i ordkunskap. Kärlek blomstrar mellan ett par av eleverna och Frökens Favorit checkar in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av eleverna tvingas checka ut när Frökens Favorit tar hans partner, och fler elever börjar känna kärleken spira. Skolans Värsting gör entré och det är ingen duvunge som kommer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!

programme.title: Andromeda: Double Helix
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver involveret i en fejde mellem en Than-planet og en nietzscheansk koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon
programme.desc: En slipstream sender Andromeda tilbage i tiden til lige før Commonwealths fald. Besætningen må gribe ind for at bevare historien.
programme.sub-title: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon

programme.title: Andromeda: Båndene der blinder
programme.desc: Besætningen besvarer et nødopkald og samler Beckas bror, som nu er Wayist, og hans ven op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lethe-bankerne
programme.desc: Et sort hul giver Dylan mulighed for at kommunikere med sin tidligere forlovede 300 år tilbage i tiden.

programme.title: Andromeda: En rose i asken
programme.desc: Dylan er fængslet på en fængselsplanet og må arrangere en flugt, mens hans besætning forsøger at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hele Neptuns store hav
programme.desc: Castalianere går om bord på Andromeda for at færdiggøre charteret for det nye Commonwealth. Da lederen bliver fundet død, er Tyr den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Perlerne, der var hans øjne
programme.desc: Beka finder ud af, at hendes fars tidligere forretningspartner handler med et stærkt vanedannende stof kaldet F lash

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårernes matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda opdager sit søsterskib, Pax Magellanic. Besætningen om bord på Pax er 300 år gammel... men er ikke blevet ældre en eneste dag.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik fra en fjern tromme
programme.desc: Tyr nødlander Eureka Maru på en nietzscheansk planet og får hukommelsestab. Han skal huske, hvad han laver, før nietzscheanerne opdager ham og hans kasse med stjålne varer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper modtager viden fra en døende Perseid, men opdager først, at Perseid blev eftersøgt af en dusørjæger, som nu har rettet sin opmærksomhed mod Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvunget perspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan bliver arresteret for at have myrdet en diktator for 300 år siden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summen af dens dele
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver bordet af en drone fra Consensus of Parts, et mytisk mekanisk samfund. Ibegyndelsen er dronen venlig, men den forsøger at tvinge skibet til at slutte sig til Consensus.

programme.title: Andromeda: Frygt og afsky i Mælkevejen
programme.desc: Gerentex er tilbage, og han kræver, at Trance og Harper hjælper ham med sin nye plan: at finde Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Djævelen tager det længste strå
programme.desc: Dylan og Rev Bem hjælper et fredeligt samfund med at stå op mod deres potentielle slavehandlere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Honningtilbuddet
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at skabe fred mellem to forskellige nietzscheanske stoltheder ved at eskortere prinsessen fra det ene sted til hendes arrangerede ægteskab med prinsen fra det andet sted.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stjernekrydsede
programme.desc: Rommies avatar bliver forelsket i det, der viser sig at være avataren af et krigsskib ved navn Gabriel. Gabriel forsøger at inficere Rommie med en virus, der sender sine planer til krigsskibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det er et dejligt lys
programme.desc: Beka tager Andromeda med til Tarn-Vedra, men længere tid i slipstrømmen giver bivirkninger. For at bekæmpe dem begynder Beka at tage Flash og bliver snart afhængig.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endelig er tiden kommet
programme.desc: En gammel erindring fra Andromeda aktiveres ved et uheld, hvilket sender hende på en mission og efterlader Dylan og besætningen ude af stand til at tilsidesætte kommandoen

programme.title: Andromeda: Det voksende kredsløb
programme.desc: Dylan og Rommie skal redde Tyr, Harper og Rev fra et Magog-verdenskib.

programme.title: Andromeda: Exitstrategier
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev og Tyr styrter ned efter at være undsluppet en bande nietzscheanere, men står snart over for en ny trussel: Rev's behov for at spise.

programme.title: Andromeda: Et hjerte for falskhed indrammet
programme.desc: Besætningen skal stjæle en juvel, som er centrum for en fejde mellem en driftsejer og Than. Beka falder for en sikkerhedschef, som tidligere var tyv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare og Torden
programme.desc: Under infiltration af et hemmeligt forbrydermøde, opdager Phoebe Thunderman, som hjælper Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen, at hendes bror Max er deltager i mødet!

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare og Torden, Anden Del
programme.desc: Under infiltration af et hemmeligt forbrydermøde, opdager Phoebe Thunderman, som hjælper Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen, at hendes bror Max er deltager i mødet!

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tvillinge-Henryer
programme.desc: Henry får en Schwoz-skabt androide til at deltage i familiemiddagen, så Henry selv kan tage til årets MMA-kamp med Charlotte og Ray.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Gravalvorligt
programme.desc: Ray begynder at opføre sig mærkeligt, og da Henry og Charlotte undersøger, hvad der er galt, får de sig en overraskelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Voldkopper
programme.desc: Piper får en mystisk sygdom, så Kaptajn Mand må rejse tilbage til 1700-tallet, for at finde den eneste kur.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jeg Kender din Hemmelighed
programme.desc: Henry har fået en mystisk besked fra en, og er bekymret for om hans hemmelige identitet er blevet afsløret.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsnarreren
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand kæmper mod tidsnarreren, ryger Faredrengen uheldigvis ind i hans tidsmaskine og gennemlever derefter den samme dag om og om igen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Faren Begynder
programme.desc: Henry Hart er en almindelig dreng i ottende klasse, indtil han bliver håndlanger for superhelten Kaptajn Mand, hvilket han skal holde hemmeligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Faren Begynder
programme.desc: Henry Hart er en almindelig dreng i ottende klasse, indtil han bliver håndlanger for superhelten Kaptajn Mand, hvilket han skal holde hemmeligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Mere Fare, Flere Problemer
programme.desc: Henry prøver at forene sig med sin nye rolle som Faredrengen, og han kæmper med at få både bekæmpelse af kriminalitet, skole, familie og venner til at gå op.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hemmeligheden Slipper ud
programme.desc: Henrys liv som Faredrengen trues, da Charlotte bliver mere mistænksom over de hemmeligheder, han gemmer på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tårer fra den Lystige Bille
programme.desc: Da Kaptajn-mand mistersin uovervindelighed, bliver han bange for at bekæmpe kriminalitet. Det er op til Faredrengen at sørge for Swellviews sikkerhed og finde ud af, hvordan Kaptajn-mand får sine kræfter tilbage.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vikaren
programme.desc: Da en mistænkelig ny elev dukker op på skolen, er Charlotte og Henry sikker på, at han har skumle planer. Kaptajn-mand bliver undercover vikar for at finde ud af mere.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare-Jasper
programme.desc: Da Jasper klæder sig ud som Faredrengen til Halloween, går han for vidt og bliver forvekslet med den rigtige. Nu er det op til den rigtige Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand at redde ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Månestenen
programme.desc: Henry kommer i vanskeligheder hjemme, da en sten fra det ydre rum viser sig, at være mere end først antaget.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Den Faldne Fødselsdagspige.
programme.desc: Henry bliver ikke inviteret til en fødselsdagsfest, fordi han bliver beskyldt for at have skubbet fødselaren ud fra hendes tag det foregående år. Kaptajn Mand træder til for at rense Henrys navn.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Lidt for God Spiller
programme.desc: Den nye elev, Shawn, tager Henrys plads på basketholdet, selvom Henry mistænker ham for at være noget ældre, end han påstår. Kaptajn Mand må overkomme gamle uoverensstemmelser for at få hjælp af en ven. Gæstestjerne: Russel Westbrook.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry Menneskebæst
programme.desc: Henry har en vigtig date, men tingene går ikke helt som planlagt, da han ved et uheld kommer i kontakt med en sær maskine i Mandehulen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Usynlige Brad
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mands ven Brad, der ved et uheld for flere år siden blev usynlig, kommer på besøg. Der går ikke længe før alle er blevet trætte af ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Afsløreren
programme.desc: Henry og Ray forsøger at stoppe en yderst irriterende forbryder, der kalder sig for Afsløreren. Piper når grænsen, i forsøget på at komme med i en utroligt populær Kaptajn Mand fanklub.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Præmietyveri
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand får Henry med i hans yndlings gameshow, Spin og Vind, i forsøget på at nå til bunds i en række forbrydelser. Men Henry ender med selv at blive offer for den samme slags forbrydelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Supervulkanen
programme.desc: Da en supervulkan under Swellview ser ud til at kunne gå i udbrud, bliver Henry og Ray overbeviste om, at Verden snart går under. Piper er overbevist om at hun har glutenallergi.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vold & Valentinsdag
programme.desc: Da pigen Henry er vild med, tager på date med en anden fyr på Valentinsdag, bygger Schwoz en androide, der kan hjælpe Henry med at gøre pigen jaloux. Ray tager på en ubehagelig date med en af Henrys lærere.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fanget i Kælderen
programme.desc: Henry, Charlotte og Rays sjove planer bliver aflyst, da Jasper kommer til at aktivere nød-nedlukningen i Skidt og Kanel.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Elevatorkysset
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen redder Bianca ender de med at kysse. Henry har det fint med det, indtil han indser at Bianca kyssede Faredrengen - og ikke Henry. Det mener Henry er det samme som at have været ham utro.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Manden i huset
programme.desc: Da Henrys mor får sin pung stjålet, beslutter Kaptajn Mand sig for at flytte hjem til Henrys familie, for at beskytte dem. Men Kaptajn Mand tager rollen som manden i huset lidt for alvorligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Drømmefangerne
programme.desc: En skurks drømmestråle rammer Henry og spærrer ham inde i en drømmetilstand, som kun Charlotte kan redde ham ud fra.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Superhelt i Stuearrest
programme.desc: Da Henry bliver taget i at snige sig ud om aftenen, får han stuearrest. Charlotte overtager hans rolle som Kaptajn Mands makker og Piper gør hvad hun kan for at drive Henry til vanvid hjemme i huset.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Klovn
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand forsøger at forbedre sit omdømme, ved at afholde en konkurrence, hvor man kan vinde en rundvisning af den hemmelige hule. Da vinderne bliver nogle af Henrys venner, bliver han bekymret for om hans identitet kan blive afsløret.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Spandefælden
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte vil gerne fortælle Jasper, at Henry i virkeligheden er Faredrengen. De beslutter sig derfor for, at finde ud af om Jasper er klar til at få det at vide.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1
programme.desc: En gruppe grafittimalere overdænger Swellview med grafittitegninger. Og imens de forsøger at finde gruppens leder, bliver Faredrengen fristet af en sød pige i gruppen, der tvinger ham til at vælge imellem pigen og Kaptajn Mand.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2
programme.desc: Faredrengen er gået med i grafittibanden, der spraymaler overalt i Swellview. Kaptajn Mand forsøger desperat at finde Faredrengen og Van, der er leder af gruppen.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Virkelige Kæreste
programme.desc: Jaspers kæreste fra sommerlejren er kommet for at besøge ham, og hun bor hos Charlotte. Men kæresten bliver jaloux, og tror at Charlotte er forelsket i Jasper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rytmerne Fortsætter
programme.desc: Da Dr. Minyak vender tilbage, er Henry pludselig i fare, da den ondskabsfulde doktor har lavet hans bedste ven Charlotte om til en super stærk skabning, der skal fange Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del
programme.desc: Henry forsøger at fange Den Gale Bedste - en gammel bedstemor, der bliver ved med at terrorisere Kaptajn Mand i offentligheden. Det giver Henry udfordringer på både arbejds- og kærlighedsfronten.
programme.sub-title: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del
programme.desc: Henrys planer for Frikadelle-festen på Swellview Junior High School er komplicerede, da han bliver nødt til også at møde op som Faredrengen. Under festen sker der ting, der gør, at han må træffe en dramatisk beslutning.
programme.sub-title: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og Sortspætterne
programme.desc: Da Pipers basketballtræner stopper, træder Henry til som træner for Pipers hold i stedet. Han forsøger at piske holdet i form, men møder udfordringer fra idrætskomitéen og deres utraditionelle regler.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Mand: på Ferie
programme.desc: Ray har givet Henry og Charlotte ansvar for Swellview, mens han er bortrejst i forbindelse med sin fætters bryllup. Der opstår problemer, da de skal klare tingene på egen hånd.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsnarreren
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand kæmper mod tidsnarreren, ryger Faredrengen uheldigvis ind i hans tidsmaskine og gennemlever derefter den samme dag om og om igen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nice Threads
programme.desc: A woman was found dead on the bedroom floor of her apartment. The crime scene yielded little of value and investigators wondered if they would find enough evidence to make a case, much less catch a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Print Conviction
programme.desc: The 1996 investigation into 48-year-old Martha Hansen's murder is helped by a legal requirement that bars have video cameras installed on the premises.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Undertaken
programme.desc: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking the Mold
programme.desc: A three-year-old develops a respiratory condition. His father has Alzheimers. An investigator reveals that their ill health is due to mold in their modern home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Innocence Lost
programme.desc: Sometime during a neighborhood Christmas party, five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared. Investigators turned to forensic science to help them see what the witnesses missed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue
programme.desc: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Private Thoughts
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Formula
programme.desc: When four-month-old Ryan Stallings dies under suspicious circumstances, his mother is ultimately convicted of his murder. But months later, new evidence emerges from a startling source — his newborn brother.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and digital imaging tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Paintball
programme.desc: In 1962, the small town residents of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida mobile home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire. Michael heroically rescues his wife and infant son. A month later, his wife is found beaten to death in a bedroom of his parents' home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg to Stand On
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered among garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, forensic anthropology and toxicology.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Slippery Motives
programme.desc: Edward Post drew a bath for his wife before going for a run. He returned to find her not breathing. She died before emergency response arrived. Police considered her death accidental until a motive surfaced.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Low Maintenance
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment. Petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.
